newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FREE STATE 111-1 IN SECOND INNINGS AT TEA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FREE STATE 111-1 IN SECOND INNINGS AT TEA.

text.p: Free State were 111 for one at tea on the third day of their Supersport series cricket match against Border at Springbok Park on Monday.
Border declared their innings closed at lunch on 367 for nine.
Scores: Free State 401 (Kosie Venter 101, Deon Jordaan 68) and 111-1 (Deon Jordaan 60 not out). Border 367-9 declared (Piet Botha 136, Peter Kirsten 56, Mark Boucher 53, Herman Bakkes 6-43).
